title: Causes of Uneven Skin Tone on Face and What Helps Each One
ex: Sun, old pimples, hormones, friction, dryness and age all cause uneven-looking skin. Learn what each looks like and the gentle care that helps.
rt: Causes of Uneven Skin Tone on Face, Explained | Mirc Glow
rd: The main causes of uneven skin tone on face: sun, acne marks, hormones, age spots, friction and dryness, with simple care for a more even-looking tone.
keyword: causes of uneven skin tone on face
quick: Uneven skin tone on the face usually comes from sun exposure, marks left after pimples, hormones such as in melasma, ageing, friction or plain dryness. Daily sunscreen, a gentle routine and a spot-focused moisturiser help most causes look more even over 8 to 12 weeks.
facts: Sun exposure is the most common cause of uneven-looking skin.
Brown marks after pimples are called post-inflammatory hyperpigmentation.
Large, symmetrical patches may be melasma and need a dermatologist.
Dry, flaky skin can look patchy even without extra pigment.
